title: Standard Ethernet Implementations Overview
markdown:
### Summary of Standard Ethernet implementations

| Characteristics | 10Base5 | 10Base2 | 10Base-T | 10Base-F |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Media | Thick coaxial cable | Thin coaxial cable | 2 UTP | 2 Fiber |
| Maximum length | 500 m | 185 m | 100 m | 2000 m |
| Line encoding | Manchester | Manchester | Manchester | Manchester |

{{viz:0}}

A single station block: 10 Mbps data enters a **Manchester encoder**,
which outputs onto twisted pairs or fibers; on the receive side, a
**Manchester decoder** recovers the 10 Mbps data. Both encoder and
decoder sit inside the "Station" boundary box, connected outward to the
two-wire medium.

{{viz:1}}
